title: a2a-admission-v0
description: What a relying party's door returned for one action under one signed MUSUBI contract, signed by the relying party. Signed bytes: the ASCII line a2a-admission-v0, a newline, then musubi-canonical-v0 of the record without signatures. Two versions of this record exist: v0 (no rules.version) and v0.1 (rules.version "0.1", 2026-10-10). They differ in presentation_ref (v0.1 may carry self_declared), revocations_seen (v0: sha256 strings; v0.1: objects that say whether each revocation carried an anchor) and the third line of does_not_establish. The reference is admission_verify_v0.py; this schema describes the shape and does not replace verify_admission. The implementation of a relying party's door is not public; a record is checked without it.

key_url.description: https URL on the relying party's own domain that serves {public_key_ed25519_b64}.

action_binding_digest.description: sha256 of musubi-canonical-v0({contract_sha256, action, target, amount, nonce, expiry_height}).

sha256.description: v0.1: sha256 of the musubi-canonical-v0 bytes of the material the applicant handed over, null when it has no canonical form. v0: the value the adapter reported.

verified.description: Computed by admit() from the material (v0.1). null means not verified. admit never reads null as true.

self_declared.description: v0.1 only. The item carried fields other than adapter and material: a result somebody else claims to have computed. The request was refused; these are the names of what was brought.

revocations_seen.description: The revocations admit() obeyed. v0: sha256 of each record without its anchor. v0.1: one object per record, saying whether it carried an anchor and the height that anchor states.

sha256.description: sha256 of the revocation record without its anchor.

anchored.description: false: the principal signed it and it was obeyed, and its time is not proven.

height.description: The height its anchor states, as stated; null when it has none. admit() does not check the anchor proof.

clause.description: The grant entry that decided, as a path, for example grant.authorized_actions[2].

evaluator_sha256.description: sha256 of clause_eval_v0.py, the clause evaluator settle imports too.

version.description: Absent in a record written by admit v0.

publication.description: Optional. The relying party's signed consent to publication. The intake stores only records that carry it.
